0.text:
Diary entry 847.

Nothing quite remarkable today.

10:30 I woke up and per usual I brushed my teeth, did my hair, changed my clothes and went out for breakfast with the family in the grand hall. Had a laugh with my dad and went back home.

11:40 The cleaners knocked apparently, they should know to use the light by now. How many times would it take for them to remember I can’t hear the knocking.

13:30 We are back out to get lunch. I’ve been practicing art in the meantime. My parents are keen on letting me know it’s a worthless skill to have. They are no fun.

14:05 When we got home the neighbor passed by to update us on the state of the Emperor. He hasn’t been seen for weeks. Granted he’s not likely to leave his palace but he hasn’t been spotted in the windows either.

16:40 I’ve stayed home. There is not much out there to do. My parents went with the neighbor.

18:30 We had dinner in the grand hall. Apparently the Emperor’s absence is a common topic at the moment. I am starting to worry myself if I’m quite honest.

22:10 Watched a scary show with my parents. It’s difficult to understand what’s happening at times but that doesn’t make it less scary. They seemed to enjoy it at least.


Diary entry 848.

Strange occurrence on an otherwise regular day.

10:30 I woke up, brushed my teeth, did my hair and went with a slightly different style than usual, hoping someone would notice. I changed clothes and went out for breakfast with the family in the grand hall.

11:30 Yesterday I missed them so today I left the door open so I can see the cleaners arrive when they come and I won’t have to rely on my very functional hearing.

13:30 Lunch time, I’ve worked some more on my art while I waited for time to pass.

15:20 My parents came home for a bit and allowed me to have some sweets. Surprisingly they actually stayed with me until dinner time.

18:30 We went back to the grand hall for dinner. The emperor has not been seen yet. Maybe he’s resting. I’m sure it’s not easy to oversee an entire system.

22:10 That same show as yesterday came on so we watched it together. However in the middle it was interrupted by an emergency broadcast. There wasn’t any imagery nor any subtitles so I’ve no idea what was said. Whatever it was, it seemed to upset my parents, they looked concerned yet.. Relieved. It’s hard to describe. They quickly send me to bed.

I’m sure they’ll tell me what that was tomorrow.


Diary entry 849.
This isn’t real. I am fairly certain this is a horrible nightmare.
I will try to write what I saw. I’m fearful.

10:30 I woke up to a cold breeze. I walked over to brush my teeth, make up my hair and change clothes. I found it strange that I couldn’t feel my parents walk around, for a moment I assumed they were off to a neighbor again. Until I stepped out of my room.

They were there, by the window, hanging from the ceiling. There was an empty noose next to them.
I haven’t looked at them since.
12:00 I’ve been sobbing and crying. It’s not just my parents. I haven’t found a single living person. I think it’s everyone.
I’ve looked out the window in the hallway. And I see more people hanging in the distance.
I don’t believe this is real.

13:40 I went to an empty apartment on the top floor. I don’t have to see anyone here. I don’t want to see anyone else.

14:44 I felt the emergency bells ringing, it was a deep rumble to my skin which I’ve only felt during tests, I stepped out on the balcony to see what was going on, hoping there would be an answer but there he was. The Emperor. And at least a hundred noblemen all slowly marching out the palace. I screamed hoping for something to happen. Nothing. They kept walking. Nobody even bat an eye. I thought the Emperor would save us. Just like he had done with so many before us. I screamed and begged.
It’s hard to write while I’m shaking.
He stopped moving in the middle of the plaza. I thought he finally heard my screams but he kneeled and looked up. His mouth moved but it was too far for me to read what he said before he burst into this red mass. I couldn’t move. My body forced me to watch as he erupted into a swarm of tendrils reaching for the ground while he grew into something horrific. The noblemen kept walking and collapsed into him, vanishing into the mass. Last thing I saw before could take control and run was the red mass growing and pulsating.

16:12 I haven't quite calmed down but I’ve at least managed to calm my breathing. This doesn’t feel real. 
I don’t understand what is happening. Or if it even is. The Emperor would never let this happen. This would never happen.
We’ve always been happy. I feel dizzy. There is a hole in my mind I cannot fill. It doesn’t make sense. Was it yesterday’s broadcast? What was even said? I wish I could fucking hear.
It’s cold here.
This must be a nightmare. It’s the only thing that makes sense. I know what they’re like, they’re just like this. They can be the worst reality while feeling completely real. 
This is the worst reality.
My parents would never leave me like this, I know they wouldn’t. And the Emperor, it cannot be real. That must be it. I need to wake up.
I have to wake up. I have to see mom and dad.
